verdict.rationale: The docs claim you can define request retries alongside model fallbacks when an error occurs (docs-7), and fallbacks can fire on request errors or set timeouts (docs-20, docs-33, docs-8). However, retry is only a one-line overview mention; the detailed evidence covers fallback to another provider rather than configurable retries against the same provider. missing for 10: documented retry-policy configuration (retry count, backoff, which errors count as transient), detailed retry docs beyond the overview line, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
